lines.text: The LORD says the shut east gate must stay closed because He entered through it, and only the prince may eat there.
Ezekiel is brought by the north gate to the front of the temple, sees the LORD's glory filling it, and falls facedown.
God rebukes Israel for bringing Philistines, uncircumcised in heart and flesh, into His sanctuary, and forbids such foreigners to enter.
The Levites who wandered after idols may not serve as priests, but God appoints them to keep charge of the temple's work.
The Levitical priests descended from Eli kept charge of the sanctuary when Israel strayed, and they alone may approach God's table.
